lede: Friday, September 25, and the web split three ways. On Wikipedia the day belonged to true crime: Lizzie Borden led all articles at 479,143 views, with Elizabeth Holmes, Aileen Wuornos and the new dramatization Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story all charting beside her. Hacker News stayed with the builders, where F-Droid 2.0 drew 1,069 points, and GitHub trended hard toward AI agents, from agent memory to agentic runtimes.
